You can help Dungeon Defenders 2 Wiki by [expanding it](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Weapons&action=edit) ._ Weapons are [hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes") \-specific gear that focuses on hero damage as it's primary stat. Most [heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes") wields a single weapon but there are some who are able to wield two. Weapons can be **Standard** _(normal types of stats and features)_ or **Unique** _(Having unique shot types or [mods](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods") )_. Most Standard weapons can be obtained through normal loot drops while Unique weapons are acquired through specific locations or vendors though there are some exceptions. There are a variety of weapons for each [heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes") to use for combat. And also cosmetic purposes. Certain weapon types such as [Polearms](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Polearms "Polearms") and [Daggers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Daggers "Daggers") can have properties of a melee and ranged weapon. [Shields](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shields "Shields") do not have any of the following properties. [![Weapon Shot Speed.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/f/f8/Weapon_Shot_Speed.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Weapon_Shot_Speed.png) ### Standard Ranged Properties [![Weapon Shot Type Example.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/0/03/Weapon_Shot_Type_Example.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Weapon_Shot_Type_Example.png) Ranged weapons have shot types and speeds depending on the weapon. [![Weapon Projectile Count.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/20/Weapon_Projectile_Count.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Weapon_Projectile_Count.png) * **Attack Speed** - How fast the weapon can shoot per second. * **Shot Type** - Determines the type of projectile and pattern. * **Number of Projectiles** - The number of projectiles the weapon shoots per shot. [![Weapon Swing Speed.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/5/51/Weapon_Swing_Speed.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Weapon_Swing_Speed.png) #### Standard Melee Properties [![Light Weapon Weight.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b2/Light_Weapon_Weight.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Light_Weapon_Weight.png) Melee weapons have different attack swings and its swing rate per [hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes") . [![Medium Weapon Weight.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/5/5c/Medium_Weapon_Weight.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Medium_Weapon_Weight.png) * **Attack Speed** - Bonus swing speed ranging from +0% to +20%. [![Heavy Weapon Weight.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/a/a5/Heavy_Weapon_Weight.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Heavy_Weapon_Weight.png) * **Light** - Each swing deals less damage but the weapon will be swung in a rapid rate. * **Medium** - Moderate damage and rate per swing. * **Heavy** - Deals heavy damage per swing but in a slower rate. Weapon Stat Types ----------------- Weapons can be equipped with every [Hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes") , and has **1 Primary stat** which is Hero Damage and **1 Secondary stat** that can be Hero Health or Ability Power. When weapons reaches the godly rarity level, **1 random Tertiary stat** will appear that can be Hero Health, Ability Power, Hero Crit Chance, Hero Crit Damage, or Movement Speed. The tertiary stat will not roll the exact same stat type as the secondary. * This also allows the attacks from that weapon to trigger combos based upon the element they are using. The additional damage is displayed as an extra line of purple numbers during attacks. Having an Element on a weapon also gives it visual effect.
